footnotes.fn_3a12f2d3:
The Albanian Government conducted the Population and Housing Census during the period of September–October 2023. The results of the census are expected to be published by the end of June 2024 and the number of persons at risk of statelessness identified will be updated accordingly.



The start-year figures are based on an identification exercise conducted in 2021 which identified a further 1,120 persons at risk of statelessness, subtracting the number of undocumented persons who had their nationality confirmed by the Albanian authorities in 2021. During 2022, an additional 350 people were assisted to confirm their nationalities through administrative and/or judicial procedures, out of which 238 were fully resolved.
